content.short: NFTTrack is a popular NFT tool to help you earn money by tracking and analyzing NFT Whales.
content.description: NFTTrack lets you follow leading NFT whales and active flippers who show high profits, helping you identify which NFT collections are currently in hot trading. The insights come from real-time activity of movers in the market, so you can spot momentum as it develops and observe where demand is strongest. In addition, NFTTrack sends free mobile alerts whenever relevant trade events occur, giving you timely notifications to stay on top of changing conditions.
